note: What a client sends to carry data from a module of its own, often a message of its own that the module has taken over. A server need do nothing with it. The header carries zero.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: 999 where the client passed the data through its own transform, 2 where it did not.

fields.name: length
fields.note: How many bytes of the data below carry anything, at most 1024.

fields.name: data
fields.note: The data, in its first length bytes; a client leaves the rest unwritten.
